summary: Surveyed all 317 listed .lean files (2,030,130 bytes total) under QuantumAlg/Core in the QudeLeap__Lean-QuantumAlg checkout: Algorithm, Base, Execution, Measure, ResourceModel subtrees. A line-start declaration grep (allowing public/private/noncomputable/@[...] modifiers, since this repo uses the Lean module system with `public def`/`public structure`) found 3,344 declaration lines; 309 of 317 files have at least one. The 8 zero-declaration files were read completely: all are Lean `module` aggregators with `public import` or `import all` lines plus a module docstring, several with an empty `section ... end` block. Under FILTER-007 such aggregators stay primary-eligible (ranked lower) because no verified auxiliary query channel exists for them, and some carry `import all` and section commands outside the pure-import class. No generated data, benchmark output, or duplicated content was found. Default disposition: retain all files; no exclusions.
